events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: You should never have had to bleed for me.
Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.
Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.
Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.
Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: You could have lost your hands.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: But I didn't lose you.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: I'm sorry.
Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You didn't hurt me.
Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.
Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You have taken my place today.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: And you are doing it better than me.
Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.
Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.
